body.heading: Draw each day
paragraphs: Each day, look at the sky with your adult. Draw the weather in that day's box: sun, cloud, rain, or wind.
Add one word under your drawing: hot, cold, blowy, or drippy. Weather words are fun to collect.

body.heading: Read your week
paragraphs: At the end of the week, look at all seven boxes. How many sunny days did you have?
Real weather watchers keep records just like this, for years and years.

takeaway: Weather watchers notice the sky a little bit every day.
safetyNotes: Look at the weather from a window or with your adult outside; never go out in stormy weather to check.
screenFreeExtension: Start a new chart next week and see if the weather repeats itself.
